# Tech Leader · Senior Level 3 (L8) · Sitecore

A Tech Leader who takes over the technical leadership of an in-flight migration from Sitecore on-premises to Sitecore XM Cloud with Next.js, for a global commercial real estate services company with a demanding, platform-savvy in-house technology team.

## Must have

- [ ] 7+ years of professional software development experience `[HR job description]`
- [ ] Leads a project's technical delivery end-to-end, managing the Developers on the team `[handbook level]`
- [ ] Hands-on technical expertise `[handbook role]`
- [ ] Project solution design `[handbook role]`
- [ ] Code review `[handbook role]`
- [ ] Mentoring `[handbook role]`
- [ ] Client communication `[handbook role]`
- [ ] Scope management `[handbook role]`
- [ ] Team branching and release strategy `[handbook level]`
- [ ] Scoping and sequencing a project, riskiest work first `[handbook level]`
- [ ] Executive reporting: value, risks, decisions `[handbook level]`
- [ ] Stakeholder management `[handbook level]`
- [ ] Experience with Sitecore Headless (JSS / Headless SXA) and Next.js `[hiring lead]`
- [ ] Experience with Sitecore XM Cloud `[hiring lead]`
- [ ] Has led a development team (people leadership, not only technical direction) on a client project `[hiring lead]`
- [ ] Has joined a project already in flight and taken over technical leadership mid-delivery (onboarding to an existing codebase, decisions and team) `[hiring lead]`
- [ ] Has worked with a demanding client that has its own strong technical team, holding technical positions and managing pushback constructively `[hiring lead]`
- [ ] English B2 or higher `[suite rule]`

## Nice to have

- Familiarity with Sitecore on-premises, the migration's source platform `[hiring lead]`

## What the person will do

- Take over the technical leadership of a migration already under way, from Sitecore on-premises to Sitecore XM Cloud with Next.js `[hiring lead]`
- Lead the day-to-day technical execution of the project `[handbook role]`
- Ensure deliverables meet timelines, quality and defined standards `[handbook role]`
- Make project-level technical and design decisions `[handbook role]`
- Guide, review and unblock the Developers through code review and direction `[handbook role]`
- Coordinate with the PM and the client's technology team on scope, estimates and risks `[handbook role]` `[hiring lead]`
- Apply architecture standards and escalate gaps and risks `[handbook role]`
- Mentor the Developers on the team `[handbook role]`
- Answer for the team's delivery KPIs: propose their targets and review them monthly with the team `[handbook role]`

## Search keywords

`Sitecore XM Cloud` `Sitecore JSS` `Headless SXA` `Next.js` `Sitecore Tech Lead` `Technical Lead` `Sitecore migration`

## Screening

1. "Tell me about the last team you led: how many people, what you were accountable for, and how you handled someone who was struggling." A good answer names a team they managed, not only advised, and a concrete people situation they handled.
2. "Have you taken over technical leadership of a project that was already running? What did you do in your first weeks?" A good answer describes getting to know an existing codebase, decisions and team, and how they set direction without restarting the work.
3. "Describe a disagreement with a client's own technical team. How did you hold or change your position?" A good answer shows a technical argument backed by evidence, respect for the client's expertise, and a resolution.
4. "Which Sitecore XM Cloud projects have you worked on, and how was the head built?" A good answer mentions JSS or Headless SXA with Next.js, and their own hands-on part in it.
5. Check in the CV or profile: 7+ years of software development, at least one role leading a development team, and Sitecore XM Cloud with Next.js named on a specific project.
6. Check English at B2 or higher.

## Not a fit if

- Has led only technically (reviews, direction) without managing the people on a team.
- Has no hands-on Sitecore XM Cloud experience, or knows Sitecore only through MVC without the headless (JSS / Headless SXA) and Next.js stack.
- Has fewer than 7 years of software development experience.
- Has only ever started projects from scratch, never taken over one mid-delivery.
- English below B2.

Terminé el JD del Tech Leader y el `opportunity.md` de la Oportunidad CBRE.

- `opportunities/cbre-sitecore-ai-migration/opportunity.md`
- `opportunities/cbre-sitecore-ai-migration/tech-leader-l8-sitecore/jd.md`
- `opportunities/cbre-sitecore-ai-migration/brief.md`, una copia del brief; el original sigue en `inbox/`.

**Qué quedó en el JD**

- **Requisitos excluyentes (Must have):** 7+ años de experiencia (Tech Lead I) y los requisitos del rol Tech Leader y del nivel L8 del handbook. Además van tus dos requisitos de plataforma (Sitecore Headless con JSS/Headless SXA y Next.js, y Sitecore XM Cloud) y tus tres prioridades del brief, con la redacción que aprobaste. Inglés B2.
- **Plus (Nice to have):** que conozca Sitecore on-prem, la plataforma de origen de la migración. Esto no lo preguntaste vos: lo agregué porque la regla del skill pide sumar la plataforma de origen como Plus cuando hay una migración. Si no lo querés, lo saco.
- **Aviso de fuera del handbook:** el JD abre con una nota que explica que el handbook no cubre Sitecore y que esos requisitos salen de tus respuestas.
- **Cliente:** en el texto del JD aparece como "a global commercial real estate services company". El slug `cbre-sitecore-ai-migration` sí figura en el encabezado de metadatos del archivo, porque la estructura de carpetas lo exige. No verifiqué si el export a PDF saca ese encabezado; lo reviso antes de que se mande afuera.

**Qué quedó afuera**
